newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine World Wide splits stock 3-for-2.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine World Wide splits stock 3-for-2.

text.p: Wolverine World Wide Inc said Thursday its directors had approved a three-for-two stock split, payable May 23, record May 2.

Wolverine also said it had approved payment of a regular quarterly dividend of $0.325 a share on a pre-split basis, unchanged from the previous quarter. The dividend is payable August 1, record July 1.
The company also said directors had adopted a new preferred stock purchase rights plan to replace an existing plan that expires in May.

Under the new plan, each share of common stock outstanding on May 8 will be entitled to 1.5 rights to buy series B preferred stock subject to terms of the rights plan. The plan was set up to encourage fair dealing in the event of a possible takeover of the company.
Wolverine makes and markets branded footwear, including Hush Puppies shoes and slippers.
